prompt: Static locked-off product commercial shot, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. A frosted pale aqua glass serum bottle with a white dropper cap and its matching aqua box stand still in shallow crystal-clear sea water on smooth pebbles. Gentle small ripples and soft caustic light patterns drift slowly across the pebbles and the base of the bottle; sunlight shimmers on the water surface; a tiny wave softly washes around the seashell. The bottle, the box and their printed labels stay perfectly still, sharp and unchanged. Calm, premium, natural daylight, realistic camera footage, no text appears, no people.
